name: paper-hub.cn
description: An easy way to read and share papers for scientific research

scripts.setup: cd backend && uv sync --frozen && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.check: cd backend && uv run python manage.py check && echo '---' && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.test: cd backend && uv run python manage.py test
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && uv run python manage.py collectstatic --noinput --clear
